verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents non-interactive, programmatic operation. Agent runs are created through an API-key-authenticated Cloud API (`client.runs.create`) on remote cloud browsers, monitored by polling events, and return results for client-side validation. The open-source Python library is pitched for automating the web at scale from your own code. That covers the core of unattended automation, but nothing in the evidence addresses CI pipelines or a local headless mode. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, documented headless mode for the local library, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
